## Checklist

- [ ] Branch named `feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/` or `chore/`.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, with British spelling.
- [ ] `main` still works — nothing half-finished is merged.
- [ ] Added a `docs/decisions.md` entry if this made a design choice.
- [ ] Added a `docs/genai-use-log.md` row if AI helped produce this.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, `.tfstate` or `.tfvars` files in the diff.
- [ ] Captured evidence into `docs/evidence/` if this is a milestone or failover test.
- [ ] A second person has reviewed this; nobody approves their own work.
